title: Tim Taylor at the Anderson case dig: 'This is the real deal'

tellings.quote: go to this dig and Tim's getting this stuff and I remember my friend said Tim said when some of the stuff came up, "This is the real deal."

plain: At a 2013 dig connected to what is called the Anderson case, some of the material that came out of the ground drew a sharp reaction from a man named Timothy Taylor: "This is the real deal." The researcher Grant Cameron tells this second-hand. He was not there, but says a friend of his told him what Taylor said as the material came up, and if true it would mean the material struck Taylor as genuinely unusual.
